subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice, require the broader daily/week calendar and drag-and-drop design first, or defer this Control UI feature?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing Control UI feature rather than a broken existing contract, and the linked PR implements only part of the requested scope while needing a substantial rebase.

options.title: Request a Fresh Narrow Timeline PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a rebased or replacement PR that implements the 24-hour timeline on the current cron page while preserving current cron contracts.

options.title: Design the Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define daily, weekly, stats, validation, and drag-and-drop behavior together.

options.title: Defer the Feature
options.body: Leave the current list/run-history UI as core for now and explicitly defer the calendar view backlog.

recommendation.title: Request a Fresh Narrow Timeline PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a rebased or replacement PR that implements the 24-hour timeline on the current cron page while preserving current cron contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest cron-specific UI feature-history signal for the existing list, filter, and run-history surface this feature would extend.
